About

Hi, I'm Alice. I'm a Product Designer based in San Diego, focused on creating digital experiences that are intuitive, thoughtful, and built around real user needs.

My background spans enterprise SaaS, AI-powered products, websites, and brand identity. Whether I'm improving a complex workflow or designing a new experience from the ground up, I enjoy turning complexity into interfaces that feel simple, clear, and purposeful.

I believe good design starts with understanding people. Every project begins by learning how users think, where they struggle, and what success looks like; then translating those insights into experiences that are both functional and visually refined.

Outside of design, I'm also a photographer. That experience has shaped my eye for composition, storytelling, and detail, influencing how I approach every product I design.

Outside the Studio

When I'm not designing, you'll usually find me along the Southern California coast with a camera in hand.

Photography has taught me to notice composition, timing, and the details that often go unseen. Those same observations shape how I design digital experiences that feel intuitive, purposeful, and human.
